svg.title: Example squad-watch hook output from a synthetic transcript
svg.desc: Example hook output from a synthetic transcript at an artificial 550 thousand tokens of context.
svg.text: [squad-watch] PROACTIVE HANDOFF — context 550k/1.0M (55%), burn 60% of the budget, reread 90%, each
turn rereads 55k weighted tokens, a new session pays for itself in 1.2 turn(s). When you close the
step in progress, without asking permission and without starting a new front: (1) record on the card
what was decided (`agenfk comment <id> "PAUSE: done X, remaining Y, next Z"`); (2) write the handoff
with mode A of the `clear-pickup` skill (ground truth by command, short, UNKNOWN for whatever you did
not verify; under Next step, what remains of the current request, in order); (3) end your reply with
the handoff path and stop. Tell the owner: `/clear` and then `/clear-pickup pickup`.
